justification: This joint dataset from the European Values Study and World Values Survey covers 92 countries and regions, including European and Eurasian nations such as Albania, Armenia, Austria, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Norway, Poland, Romania, Russia, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and Ukraine. It provides standardized micro-data on work and employment, national identity, religion, family life, political behavior, gender roles, and environmental values.

EVS Wave 5 (fieldwork 2017–2021) covers 37 participating European countries and territories. The survey measures core human values across key themes including labour and employment, cultural and national identity, religion and values, family life and marriage, political attitudes, gender roles, and environmental protection.

returned_title: World Values Survey: Round Seven - Country-Pooled Datafile (2017-2022)
justification: WVS Round 7 covers representative national samples surveyed between 2017 and 2022 in European and Eurasian countries such as Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Czechia, Georgia, Germany, Great Britain, Netherlands, Romania, Russia, Serbia, Slovakia, and Ukraine. It contains comprehensive indicators on economic life/employment, national identity, religious beliefs, family relations, political participation, gender equality, and climate/environmental attitudes.

ESS Round 10 (2020–2022) surveyed over 30 European countries (including Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czechia, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and Great Britain). Its core and rotating modules collect individual-level data on employment, socio-cultural identity, religious affiliation, family contacts, political attitudes/trust, gender issues, and environmental/climate perceptions.

Provides cross-national survey data collected between 2020 and 2022 across numerous target European countries (including Belgium, Bulgaria, Czechia, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, and the UK). The dataset covers political trust, national and cultural identity, economic evaluations, democracy perception, and security concerns.

Contains disaggregated disaggregated data through 2023 for all target countries (EU members, candidate states, UK, Moldova, Georgia, Turkey, Western Balkans). It measures political systems, government institutions, conflict and security, political behavior, and democratic health in the 2020s.

returned_title: Standard and Special Eurobarometer Data Service
justification: Hosts regular microdata datasets from Eurobarometer survey waves conducted during the 2020s across EU member states and candidate/neighboring countries. It measures public attitudes toward national and international political organizations, economic indicators, security perceptions, and socio-cultural identity.

Offers annual public opinion survey datasets throughout the 2020s covering Western Balkan nations (Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia). Key themes include trust in political institutions, economic conditions, regional security, and international organization perceptions.
Provides empirical data on voter behavior, political attitudes, party preferences, and campaign perceptions surrounding the 2021 German Bundestag election.
Measures political orientation, trust in government institutions, social values, and democratic attitudes among the German public in 2021.
Aggregates monthly representative public opinion surveys in Germany during 2021, tracking party support, government satisfaction, political issues, and voting behavior.
Surveys parliamentary candidates in the 2021 German federal election, capturing information on campaign strategies, political party organisations, and elite political attitudes.
Provides comprehensive survey data on the German population in 2021 covering political attitudes, environmental concerns, media usage, social conditions, values, and employment status.
Representative multi-cohort longitudinal study tracking employment, social indicators, psychological well-being, income, consumption, and living conditions in Germany up through 2021.
Part of the German Longitudinal Election Study capturing political behavior, media consumption, public attitudes, and social indicators in Germany around the 2021 federal election.

returned_title: GESIS Panel Special Survey on the Coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 Outbreak in Germany
justification: Captures psychological reactions, social behavior and attitudes, employment impacts, media consumption, and institutional trust in Germany during the 2020 pandemic context.

returned_title: Socio-Economic Panel, data from 1984-2023 (SOEP-Core, v40, Remote Edition)
justification: Provides comprehensive longitudinal survey data on German households covering economic conditions, income, labour and employment, working conditions, general health and well-being, psychology, family life, social stratification, migration, and consumption.
Covers German social conditions, political behaviour and attitudes, information society and media usage, government systems, equality/inequality and social exclusion, and general health indicators.

returned_title: German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES Querschnitt 2021, Vor- und Nachwahl)
justification: Captures representative empirical data on political behaviour, elections, political systems and organisations, media usage, international politics, and political attitudes in Germany during the 2021 federal election.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme: Environment IV - ISSP 2020
justification: Includes data for Germany covering public attitudes toward the natural environment, conservation, energy and natural resources, economic growth versus environmental protection, transport/travel behavior, and government policy.

returned_title: News on TikTok: An Annotated Dataset of TikTok Videos from German-Speaking News Outlets in 2023
justification: This dataset consists of human-coded annotations for over 4,000 TikTok videos published in 2023 by German-speaking news outlets. It explicitly incorporates journalism research concepts including news value theory, visual style, and text presentation on social media.

returned_title: Die Themen 'Umwelt' und 'Corona' in der medialen Berichterstattung während der ersten Coronawelle in Deutschland 2020
justification: This dataset provides quantitative content analysis for 15,038 news items across German national print outlets and social media channels (such as Tagesschau on Instagram, rbb24 on Twitter, and RTLaktuell on Facebook) during early 2020 in Germany.
